sloka: आमन्त्र्य तु महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ।भरतं लक्ष्मणं चैव महारथमुपारुहत् ।। ७.७२.२० ॥
transliteration: āmantrya tu mahātmānaṁ rāmaṁ satyaparākramam ।bharataṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva mahārathamupāruhat ।। 7.72.20 ॥

translations.english: Having bid farewell to the great-souled Rama of true valor, and also to Bharata and Lakshmana, he then ascended a great chariot.
